title: SentryVLA: Uncertainty-Guided Action Selection and State Monitoring for Vision-Language-Action Robotic Control
abstract: arXiv:2604.16677v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as generalist robotic controllers that map visual observations and language instructions to continuous actions. However, pretrained VLAs typically provide limited information about the reliability of their generated actions, making deployment challenging when execution failures must be anticipated. We address this problem by introducing SentryVLA, a lightweight runtime wrapper for frozen VLA policies. At the action level, SentryVLA uses conformalized quantile regression to estimate a calibrated upper bound on the deviation between sampled VLA actions and expert-like behavior under the calibration distribution. The predicted deviation is then used to rank multiple stochastic candidates for action selection. translated_title: SentryVLA：面向视觉-语言-动作机器人控制的不确定性引导动作选择与状态监控
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已经发展成为通用的机器人控制器，能够将视觉观察和语言指令映射为连续动作。然而，预训练的VLA模型通常对其所生成动作的可靠性所提供的信息十分有限，这使得在需要预判执行失败的场景下部署变得困难。我们通过引入SentryVLA来解决这一问题，这是一个作用于冻结VLA策略之上的轻量级运行时包装器。在动作层面，SentryVLA使用保形分位数回归（conformalized quantile regression）来估计在校准分布下采样的VLA动作与类专家行为之间偏差的校准上界，随后利用预测的偏差对多个随机候选动作进行排序以完成动作选择。在执行监控层面，SentryVLA对在最终动作预测之前提取的上下文化潜在执行状态应用基于马氏距离的异常评分……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SentryVLA是一个作用于冻结VLA策略的轻量级运行时包装器，通过保形分位数回归实现不确定性引导的动作选择，并利用基于马氏距离的异常评分监控执行状态，从而提升机器人控制部署的可靠性。
en_tdlr: SentryVLA is a lightweight runtime wrapper for frozen VLA policies that enables uncertainty-guided action selection via conformalized quantile regression and monitors execution states using a Mahalanobis-distance-based anomaly score.
